mentions.name: Hourbun
mentions.description: Existing invoicing tools became prohibitively expensive when Harvest raised its price roughly 10x, and other options suffered from bad UI/UX, so the author built an affordable, quick, and reliable alternative for invoicing clients.
mentions.problem: Invoicing apps like Harvest raised prices ~10x, leaving people and teams needing a quick, reliable way to invoice clients without paying a premium or suffering bad UI/UX.
mentions.audience: This is a fast, intuitive time tracking and invoicing app for individuals and teams to invoice clients quickly and reliably.
mentions.source_excerpt:
And I did: https://hourbun.com/

Just an intuitive and fast time tracking and invoicing app built for people and teams like me who want a quick and reliable way of invoicing clients without paying a premium or suffer through bad UI/UX.
mentions.author: fredwu
